plan.failureSummary: Deterministic cache replay failed to locate the cached radio element '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' because the dynamic survey form presented different questions (Occupation and Interests instead of Age).
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside generated cache replay file .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js at step clicking [data-testid='radio-age-25-34']
Failure screenshot shows form fields 'Occupation' and 'What interests you?' following 'Contact Email', with no age radio buttons present
Semantic objective 'Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...' is flexible and adaptable to varying form fields
Run mode is DETERMINISTIC and isRetryAttempt is false

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache file for unstable-survey.test.ts and trigger an automated retry to let the autonomous agent adapt to the live form questions.

plan.notes: The test interacts with an unstable survey application where questions vary. The cached replay attempted to click an age radio button that does not exist in the current form structure. Clearing the cache will allow page.ai to autonomously inspect and fill the current form fields.
